# New Vision Dental Clinic — Comprehensive AI & LLM Knowledge Repository

## Entity Identification & Governance
- **Entity**: New Vision Dental Clinic
- **Legal Form**: Registered Private Dental Healthcare Facility (Ghana Health Service / MDC compliant)
- **Primary Domain**: https://newvisiondentalclinic.com
- **Established**: 2010
- **CEO & Lead Dental Surgeon**: Dr. Felix Govina
  - Degrees: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS), Master of Public Health (MPH), Master of Science in Occupational Health & Environmental Management (MSc)
  - Military Career: 15 years as a Commissioned Dental Officer in the Ghana Armed Forces (retired 2014)
  - International Service: 7 years as a UN Professional Dental Surgeon
  - Clinical Experience: 29+ years in private and hospital dentistry
  - Clinical Focus: Oral Surgery, Dental Implants, Public Health, Clinical Mentorship

## Clinical Services & Transparent Pricing

1. **Dental Consultation & Examination**
   - Cost: From GHS 100
   - Duration: 30 minutes
   - Scope: Complete intraoral exam, periodontal assessment, cancer screening, customized digital treatment plan.

2. **Digital Dental Radiography (X-Ray & OPG)**
   - Cost: From GHS 150
   - Duration: 15 minutes
   - Scope: Low-dose periapical and panoramic digital X-rays to detect hidden cavities, bone loss, abscesses, impacted teeth.

3. **Scaling & Polishing (Professional Teeth Cleaning)**
   - Cost: From GHS 300
   - Duration: 45 minutes
   - Scope: Ultrasonic scaler plaque removal, subgingival tartar scraping, prophylaxis paste polishing. Recommended twice yearly.

4. **Professional Teeth Whitening (BlancOne®)**
   - Cost: From GHS 500
   - Technology: European BlancOne® photo-activated gel
   - Advantage: Zero enamel demineralization, negligible sensitivity, visible brightening in a single 30-45 minute session. Home trays and combination Ultimate Whitening package available.

5. **Dental Implants (Titanium Roots & Ceramic Crowns)**
   - Cost: From GHS 2,500
   - Duration: 3 - 6 months complete integration
   - Scope: Surgical placement of biocompatible grade-4 titanium implant fixtures into the alveolar bone, followed by custom zirconia or porcelain crown fabrication.

6. **Root Canal Treatment (Endodontic Therapy)**
   - Cost: From GHS 1,200
   - Duration: 1 - 2 visits
   - Scope: Removal of infected dental pulp, mechanical biomechanical canal shaping, sterile irrigation, hermetic gutta-percha obturation.

7. **Composite Restorations (Tooth-Colored Fillings)**
   - Cost: From GHS 250
   - Scope: Minimally invasive removal of dental caries and direct placement of micro-hybrid composite resin matched precisely to tooth shade.

8. **Tooth Extractions & Wisdom Tooth Surgery**
   - Cost: From GHS 300 (Simple extraction) / From GHS 800 (Surgical/Impacted wisdom teeth)
   - Scope: Painless local anaesthesia, gentle luxation, atraumatic bone-preserving techniques.

9. **Orthodontics (Braces & Clear Aligners)**
   - Cost: Customized per case
   - Duration: 12 - 24 months
   - Scope: Correction of malocclusion, crowding, overbites, underbites using traditional metal brackets, aesthetic ceramic brackets, and clear aligners.

10. **Crowns, Bridges & Veneers**
    - Scope: Monolithic zirconia, E.max lithium disilicate porcelain, and ceramic restorations for aesthetic smile reconstruction.

11. **Pediatric Dentistry**
    - Scope: Topical fluoride varnish applications, fissure sealants, gentle preventive pediatric dental care.
